description: Deletes records by id or key, or by a FetchXML query, and removes many-to-many links. Always destructive.

records.description: Records to delete. One already gone is skipped.

key.description: Alternate key values by column, instead of id.

query.description: Delete what a FetchXML query matches. The plan refuses when it matches more than maxCount.

fetchXml.description: FetchXML of the table to delete from. Only the main entity's rows are deleted.

maxCount.description: The most records this may delete, 1 to 1000.

disassociate.description: Links to remove (disassociate). The records stay.

table.description: Table logical name of the record the links start from.
